summary: Iteration 39 — NEW FEATURE Assignment Template Library. FULL PASS across backend (24/24 new + 26/26 phase1 regression = 50/50) and frontend (all 22 review items verified via Playwright). BACKEND: Created /app/backend/tests/test_assignment_templates.py (6 test classes / 24 tests): (1) GET /api/assignment-templates — requires auth (401/403 without); returns list; can_edit=True for author and super_admin, False for other instructors; (2) POST /api/assignment-templates — happy path (submission_type=10_slide_pitch, 3 milestones with fresh milestone_ids); 400 on missing name; 400 on unknown submission_type; server generates milestone_ids when payload omits them; (3) POST /api/assignment-templates/from-assignment/{aid} — snapshots auto-seeded 60_second_pitch (14 milestones); 403 for non-manager instructor; 200 for super_admin; 404 for missing assignment; (4) PUT /api/assignment-templates/{id} — author updates; other instructor 403; super_admin updates; unknown template 404; (5) DELETE /api/assignment-templates/{id} — author deletes (verified in mongo); other instructor 403 (doc preserved); (6) POST /api/cohorts/{cohort_id}/assignments/from-template/{template_id} — default {} creates new custom assignment with template's original weeks (fresh milestone_ids, replaced=False); week_map={ms_id:5} remaps only that milestone (others keep original weeks); week_map={ms_id:null} SKIPS that milestone (count -=1); replace_existing_by_type=True on 60_second_pitch overwrites in place (assignment_id PRESERVED, submission linkage preserved via seeded fake sub, milestones+title updated, replaced=True); title_override sets new title on new assignment; 404 for missing template + missing cohort; 403 for non-manager instructor. REGRESSION: 26/26 test_assignments_phase1 pass together (50/50 combined in 27.8s). FRONTEND (Playwright w/ super_admin ephemeral token on new ephemeral cohort cohort_cbb935be29a8, total_weeks=10): (a) /assignment-templates renders 'assignment-templates-page'; 'new-template-btn' visible in header (empty-new-template-btn is only shown when list is empty — 6 stale templates from prior iterations were pre-existing, which is expected). (b) 'new-template-btn' opens 'template-form-dialog' with name/description/drive/tpl-submission-type-select/feedback-template fields. (c) 'template-preset-kawasaki' populates exactly 14 milestone rows; last row (idx=13) 'template-milestone-13-capstone' is CHECKED. (d) Save creates template via POST /api/assignment-templates; card appears with name, '60 SECOND PITCH · 14 milestones' badge, W1-W8 chips + '+6 more', creator name + 'YOU' badge. (e) 'edit-template-{id}' opens dialog pre-filled with the template name. (f) Sidebar 'assignment-templates-link' present on /dashboard with href=/assignment-templates alongside library-link + rubrics-link. Note: no explicit 'cohorts-link' testid — the dashboard IS the cohorts view (Dashboard link). Not a regression. (g) Cohort → Assignments tab: 'apply-template-btn' visible next to 'new-assignment-btn'; 4 'save-as-template-{aid}' bookmark icons on assignment cards. (h) 'apply-template-btn' opens 'apply-template-dialog'; 'apply-template-select' lists 7 templates; picking 'TEST_ITER39_Playwright_Tpl · Pitch' renders 14 'apply-template-milestone-row-*' entries; each has week input + skip checkbox. (i) 'apply-template-rescale-btn' rescales proportionally to cohort.total_weeks=14 (rescale target is cohort's total_weeks, tested rows spread accordingly); 'apply-template-reset-btn' + 'apply-template-replace-existing' (default TRUE) + 'apply-template-title-override' all present. (j) Setting title_override='TEST_ITER39_Applied_Title' + confirm with replace_existing=True on auto-seeded 60_second_pitch cohort: dialog closes, toast shows, assignment card refreshes and now shows 'TEST_ITER39_Applied_Title' with '60 Second Pitch · 14 milestones' — assignment_id preserved (in-place update). (k) Clicking 'save-as-template-{aid}' (BookmarkPlus icon) on an assignment card creates a new template via POST /api/assignment-templates/from-assignment/{aid} and shows 'Saved as template — TEST_ITER39_Applied_Title' toast. No console errors in any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2362 _normalize_milestone_shape PRESERVES existing milestone_id when present (m.get('milestone_id') or f'ms_...'). This is intentional for the from-assignment snapshot path so that the preview UI (ApplyTemplateDialog) can reference milestones by their template ms_id in week_map. Regeneration happens ONLY at apply-time in _clone_milestones_from_template (line 2395). Clean design.
server.py:2397 sort key (week_number, is_final_capstone_int) — capstones sort AFTER regular milestones of the same week. Consistent with iteration 38.
server.py:2422 questionnaire_fields only stored when submission_type=='business_questionnaire'. Nice guard; prevents leaking questionnaire config into other types.
server.py:2413 Name validation strips whitespace and rejects empty. Good — matches the 400 test expectation.
server.py:2529 replace_existing_by_type queries is_active=True — soft-deleted assignments are correctly ignored so a fresh assignment is created if the previous one was deactivated. Good.
server.py:2440 from-assignment permission check uses is_cohort_manager on the cohort of the source assignment. Correct — you must be able to manage the cohort you're snapshotting from.
server.py:2513 apply-template permission uses is_cohort_manager on the TARGET cohort — correct (author of the template need not manage the target cohort; only the target-cohort manager should apply).

AssignmentsTab.js:161 save-as-template-{assignment_id} uses BookmarkPlus icon — no window.confirm, one-click snapshot. UX is snappy but there's no confirmation before creating a duplicate template. Consider a toast + Undo action if repeated clicks by mistake becomes an issue in production. Not blocking.

AssignmentTemplatesPage.js:242 PUT sends the entire form payload (including submission_type in create mode but NOT in edit — the field isn't in the edit branch). Reasonable — submission_type shouldn't change post-create (same rationale as iteration 38's assignment edit).

ApplyTemplateDialog.js:179 rescale-btn maps weeks proportionally to cohort.total_weeks. Verified working with total_weeks=14 (rescale keeps max at 14; when tested with a 10-week cohort in an earlier run, weeks were compressed 1–10). Good.

Sidebar.js — order is Dashboard, Submissions, Progress, Library, Rubrics, Templates, Thinkific, (Admin). Review-request mentions 'Cohorts, Submissions, Library, Rubrics, Templates' — 'Cohorts' is effectively Dashboard (contains cohort cards). Not a bug, just naming clarification for the main agent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 39 is a NEW FEATURE (Assignment Template Library) building on iteration 38's Phase 1 Assignments refactor. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_assignment_templates.py is the canonical regression for the template CRUD + apply flow — keep in the standard suite. Frontend: AssignmentTemplatesPage.js exports the list page + create/edit dialog + milestone builder; ApplyTemplateDialog.js exports the apply-to-cohort remap dialog; both wired from AssignmentsTab.js (line 21) and App.js route /assignment-templates (line 147). rca of the issue: No production bugs found this iteration. One initial test failure was self-inflicted: I assumed _normalize_milestone_shape would regenerate milestone_ids during from-assignment snapshotting, but by design it only regenerates them at APPLY time (_clone_milestones_from_template). This is correct behavior — the ApplyTemplateDialog UI needs stable template-side ms_ids to reference in week_map. Fixed the test to assert milestone shape (id present + starts with ms_) rather than id-disjointness. Everything else worked first-try — E1's implementation is clean and matches the review-request spec exactly.
